content.expected_result: Resolve an annotation authored before its endpoints.
preconditions: An annotation can be authored before its referenced prototype or story content is available; use known exact intended content digests.

steps.action: Author the selector and exact content pins, compose with missing endpoints, then make those exact endpoint values available and compose again.
steps.expected_result: The unresolved annotation remains loadable with explicit gaps. Exact matching content resolves the same edge in both navigation directions.

steps.action: Compare the public annotation prototype/story content pins and selector with the authored values.
steps.expected_result: All explicit pins and selector values remain exact; no newer endpoint content is substituted.

content.title: Resolve an annotation authored before its endpoints
